name: com.volt48/agent-door
title: VOLT48 — 48V DC telecom power
description: 48V DC telecom power: rectifier modules, controllers, LiFePO4 batteries by part number. No prices.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search VOLT48's catalogue of 48V DC telecom power equipment — rectifier modules (Eltek Flatpack2/Flatpack S, Huawei R4850G2, Vertiv/Emerson NetSure, Delta ESR, Eaton APR48, ZTE ZXDU), plant controllers and 48V LiFePO4 batteries — by part number, brand or model. Returns lifecycle status, models and part numbers. No prices or lead times.

tools.name: get_family
tools.description: Full detail of one product family by id: lifecycle status, models and part numbers, applications, what to send for a quotation, honest alternatives, page.

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Where VOLT48 stands today (selecting manufacturing partners, no orders yet), condition policy, markets, compliance and contacts.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Record a sourcing requirement with VOLT48 on behalf of a buyer (telecom operator, ISP, integrator, data-centre team): part numbers or descriptions with quantities. VOLT48 is selecting its manufacturing partners; the request is recorded and quoted once a supplying factory is confirmed. Nothing is binding and nothing is sent automatically. It registers the buyer's contact details with VOLT48.
